shared: Pile Heat on one or two pieces turn after turn, then cash it into big stats.
differ: What Heat does on its own: nothing until cards read it, fight-only Attack, or growth that cools.

takes.label: Heat buys keywords
takes.line: Each heat-up adds +1/+1 and a brief wound; Heat thresholds grant Shield, Cleave, Swoop; you wound your own units for Attack.
takes.look_if: keyword goals to chase, and wounding your own board on purpose.

takes.label: Glass cannon, then harden
takes.line: Heat itself is fight-only Attack, no Health; cash it into stats now, or hold to 10 Heat for +3/+3 each.
takes.look_if: a risky glass cannon you harden at exactly the right moment.

takes.label: Heat grows, then cools
takes.line: Heat grows a unit +1/+1 per Heat each turn, then fades; it burns the unit in fights, unless the enemy takes it.
takes.look_if: growth that runs itself, with neighbours multiplying one piece.
